lines.text: Meet Swipe Mode. Read your LinkedIn feed, one post at a time.
Install it in four clicks: turn on Developer mode, click Load unpacked, and pick the extension folder.
Click the Swipe Mode button, or press Alt, Shift, S.
Each post gets the whole card.
Not for you? Press left to skip.
Changed your mind? U brings it back.
Right opens your options. It never likes anything on its own.
Press R, then a number, to react.
Swipe Mode moves on once LinkedIn confirms.
Press C to write a comment, and Control Enter to post it.
Escape takes you back to your feed, right where you started.
Eight keys. Every action stays your choice.
